summary.text: Reverse Worm Dragon is a killer move Duke Long calls reverse worm dragon.

claims.text: In immemorial white heaven’s qi path battlefield, dragon roars sound in the fog. Clouds gather into giant dragon qi currents. Spiral currents split the battlefield into multiple areas and devour fog as they expand. Fang Yuan’s true body is exposed. He calls it a split move, one of four main killer move manipulation techniques. While they fought, the currents had seemed like minor moves. They were parts of one qi path killer move.

Duke Long says this move is called reverse worm dragon. He says he only succeeded after ten years of practicing it. He says any qi path methods used on the currents will help them grow from worm to dragon, their power rising by a hundred times. Fang Yuan did not see Duke Long use this reverse worm dragon move in his previous life. Fang Yuan thinks reverse worm dragon seems to have been created to counter battlefield killer moves.

Fang Yuan attacks with blade qi. The spiral currents absorb much of it and grow rapidly. More than ten currents fuse into one divine dragon that fills the qi path battlefield. Fang Yuan calls it turning worm into dragon. He uses Yin-yang Great Killer Hands. Two huge hands, one black and one white, grab the qi dragon’s neck and tail. He pulls from afar and snaps the dragon in two.
Duke Long’s qi path combat system includes reverse worm dragon as a killer move specially prepared to target battlefield killer moves.
